layout.concept: Split-pane terminal workbench layout engineered for sub-millisecond visual feedback and dual-pane operational control. The left quadrant houses source media ingestion, procedural parameters, and tier controls, while the central viewport expands into an unclipped high-density ASCII rendering canvas framed by real-time hardware telemetry and sandbox status badges.
layout.alignment_rationale: Terminal consoles and high-throughput rendering workbenches strictly adhere to left-aligned monospace rhythm for rapid column scanning and zero typographical drift.

principles: Visual identity fuses retro-futuristic CRT precision with rigorous modern desktop productivity. Deliberately rejects generic SaaS gradients in favor of high-legibility phosphor luminescence, hard-edged telemetry panels, and functional monospace typography tailored for multiplatform GPU ASCII rendering.

orchestrated_moment.trigger: initial load reveal and tier switch
orchestrated_moment.justification: Hero ASCII canvas undergoes a single 280ms character rasterization cascade on startup to establish the matrix resolution and hardware tier. All subsequent interactions, slider adjustments, and mode switches execute instantly with zero UI latency or transition jank.

tells_checked: Checked cream/terracotta tell: rejected warm-clay editorial palettes; selected Void Black (#0a0a0f) and Phosphor Terminal Green (#00ff88) engineered for terminal console environments.

Checked near-black/acid-green slop: rejected toxic fluorescent green on pitch black; calibrated Phosphor Green to WCAG AA-compliant #00ff88 with Cold Chrome (#f0f0f5) primary text for readable luminance contrast.
Checked broadsheet layout: rejected newspaper hairline columns; implemented structured split-pane workbench optimized for dual-column controls and unconstrained ASCII canvas.

Checked SaaS card kit tell: rejected uniform rounded cards with generic drop shadows; implemented dense 6px/4px border-radius hierarchy with subtle border framing (#262638) and specialized phosphor glow accents.

Checked template chrome tell: stripped tracked-out ALL-CAPS eyebrows, middot separators, and arrow CTA suffixes; used clean sentence-case badges, semantic status pills, and direct imperative button labels.
